name_en: Tamil Nadu Manual Workers Social Security and Welfare Board - member benefits
name_ta: தமிழ்நாடு உடல் உழைப்பு தொழிலாளர்கள் சமூக பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் நல வாரியம்
department: Labour Welfare and Skill Development Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Manual workers who join the Board (or one of the other unorganised workers boards) can get help money: Rs 1,000 pension a month, Rs 1,25,000 if the member dies in an accident, Rs 30,000 on natural death, Rs 5,000 for funeral costs, Rs 3,000 (men) or Rs 5,000 (women) for marriage, Rs 6,000 for having a baby, money for children's studies, and up to Rs 500 for glasses.

other: You must work in one of the manual jobs listed under the Tamil Nadu Manual Workers Act, 1982.
You can join from age 18 until you turn 60.
You need a work certificate from your employer, a registered trade union, a Labour Department officer, or the Village Administrative Officer (Revenue Inspector in Chennai).
Membership lasts 5 years or until you turn 60, whichever comes first.

documents: Work certificate (from employer, trade union, labour officer or VAO)
One age proof: birth certificate, voter ID, school or college certificate, driving licence, ration card, Aadhaar card, or a government doctor's certificate
how_to_apply: Fill Form-1, stick one photo on it and attach another, and add your work certificate and age proof. The Labour Officer (Social Security Scheme) of your district registers you after the VAO checks it. You can apply and renew online on the Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Welfare Board website.
where_to_apply: tnuwwb.tn.gov.in (online), or the district Labour Officer (Social Security Scheme)

gaps: age_max is 59 because the page says the worker must not have 'completed 60 years of age'.

Benefit amounts come from the 'Workers Registered in other Welfare Boards' column of the tnuwwb.tn.gov.in claims list, which covers this Board and the other non-construction boards. The PDF has no date printed on it.
The 2023-24 Policy Note column for 'TNMWSSWB and 15 other welfare boards' was read but not quoted, because its table text is jumbled when copied.
The older labour.tn.gov.in benefit page gives lower amounts (e.g. natural death Rs 15,000, funeral Rs 2,000); the newer tnuwwb claims list is used.
Pension age (60) is not stated for this Board on the sources used; only the amount is.
The registration page (labour.tn.gov.in) describes the paper process; how Form-1 and certificates map to the online form is not stated.
The full list of covered jobs (the Act schedule) was not saved; the Policy Note says 70 manual job categories.
Source does not give a helpline number.
